#+title: Consumer-owned Org Contracts

* Review evidence
:PROPERTIES:
:CONTRACT_ID: customer.review-evidence
:CONTRACT_SCOPE: subtree
:END:

#+begin_src scheme :org-contract
(assert-org-element "customer.review-has-link" error
  (bindings)
  (org-elements link (descendant-of scope))
  (expect at-least 1)
  (message "review requires a link")
  (fix "add a linked source to the review"))
#+end_src

* Document tasks
:PROPERTIES:
:CONTRACT_ID: customer.has-task
:CONTRACT_SCOPE: document
:END:

#+begin_src scheme :org-contract
(assert-org-element "customer.has-task-headline" warning
  (bindings)
  (org-elements headline (property todo-type "todo"))
  (expect at-least 1))
#+end_src
